result.title: COMET: Decoupled Distillation, Routing, and Capacity Control for Task-Agnostic Continual Vision--Language Learning
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP retain zero-shot recognition ability, but their open-world use often requires task-agnostic continual learning: tasks arrive sequentially, past data are unavailable, task identity is unknown, and the backbone cannot be retrained. We argue that this setting fails VLMs through three coupled pressures beyond the stability-plasticity tradeoff: (1) modal-consistency drift, (2) representation-space interference, and (3) per-task capacity shortfall. We propose COMET (Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer) to resolve these three issues respectively as follows. A frozen teacher provides only a feature reference on a shared image-text pool; Tri-Affinity Distillation preserves image-image, text-text, and image-text geometry; and Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation aligns new experts with compatible prior experts so routing errors degrade gracefully. We design COMET to keep capacity and inference separate: a contextual bandit keeps or merges full per-task experts using post-training signals, while a reconstruction router selects sparse experts at test time without teacher semantics. On the X-TAIL benchmark, we show that each proposed component improves continual learning performance. COMET shows that continual vision-language adaptation can preserve multimodal geometry, coordinate accumulated experts, and allocate capacity jointly when feature reference, expert shaping, routing, and capacity control are separated by construction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 COMET，在冻结 CLIP 骨干下以解耦的三亲和蒸馏、跨专家蒸馏、contextual bandit 容量控制与重建路由实现任务无关的持续视觉-语言学习，并在 X-TAIL 上验证各组件。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作关注无任务标识、无旧数据的持续学习与专家路由/容量分配，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成、视觉证据筛选或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类决策，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系，MoE 路由仅属术语层面相似。
